title: Core: AS2 Object literal and Array literal compilation
description: Verify AS2 object and array literals compile: var o = {x: 1, y: 2}, var a = [1, 2, 3], nested: {nested: {deep: true}}, mixed: [{x:1}, {x:2}]. Verify ActionInitObject (0x43) and ActionInitArray (0x42) opcodes are emitted. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/literals.test.ts.
